card.name: Digits in converted measurement values
card.fires_on: A digit inside a number in a parenthetical unit conversion, such as inches, mCi, or °F, right after a metric or other value. It fires most when the number is a converted equivalent of the range just before it.

modes.label: Dose conversions
modes.description: Digits in the parenthetical mCi equivalent of an MBq dose range.

modes.label: Size and length conversions
modes.description: Digits in the inch or foot equivalent of a metric size.

modes.label: Coordinates and temperatures
modes.description: Digits in decimal coordinates or Fahrenheit equivalents.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly unrelated Chinese words, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It marks a digit inside the converted number in brackets after a measurement, like the mCi figure after MBq.
